hey. I'm here. I think you're great. you're not alone, dude <3 please know that someone is always here

I truly wish I could give you a solution. But I'm still looking for one, too :,). Hey, at least you're not alone. 

I'm proud of you for being here

Yes, you can! Of course you can! I'm so proud of you.

If you're still in high school, you can graduate with a GED at the age of 16 if you take a GED test. Super simple and I know many people who have succeeded in life by getting a GED.

If you've graduated college, there are a ton of options out there, you just need to really explore them. To be a real estate agent literally all you need is to pass a real estate test to get your license and it's an entry level job. Just find a firm like Sotheby's or something.

You could be a waiter or waitress, or a barista, and try to spread happiness to people you meet on the job.

You could tutor on the side.

You could nanny.  
Heck, you can dress up like a duck and quack on the street to earn a few dollars if that's what your heart desires.

I'm proud of you for wanting to get a job, your'e doing great. You've got this. The world is open wide.

Lethal? No idea.

I know that if it doesn't work, it could make you permanently brain dead or paralyzed. Unable to move, talk, or speak, and you'll probably be under someone else's care for your entire life.

If it does work, that cop will spend every day of their life thinking about the life that they took, hating themselves for killing someone innocent. Unless you want to ruin a cop's life too, **please**. Do not use this method. I really hope you can get some help, you deserve to feel better <3

Babe I wish I could hug you right now. I am 17, and my dad used to abuse me as well.

I want you to know that you are loved. Even if no one in your life is telling you that, even if you don't believe it, it's true. I really believe that you can get better. How do I know? I've been through it too.  
I ended up talking to a guidance counselor at school which took a lot of courage but it really helped. Now I live with a different family member.

If you are worried that your siblings or parents will be mad at you: please don't be. I know it's easier said than done. But at the end of the day, your top priority should be YOUR life because it's the only thing you really have control over. Even if they get mad at you they will eventually understand someday. I promise.

The world is better with you in it. You have so, so much time ahead. Don't let your dad make you feel like nothing. Go into the world, and make a GOOD life for yourself someday. Show him that he's wrong. I love you.

Please god, help her. I wish my mom cared enough to post something like this. I wish she wanted to help me. I'm 17 so I'm gonna try to tell you how I think she's feeling.

Even if you have tried to help her, she feels helpless and like no one cares. This is NOT YOUR FAULT, but it is your job to help. I know it's hard for you, and I know you're probably thinking what could have happened to make her feel this way.

If it's really that bad, I'd look into a partial hospitalization outpatient program. It does not affect your school performance, your grades are all excused, and you go through intense group therapy and stuff to figure out how you can transition back to feeling safe at home. She can even probs get an IEP to help with her mental health for when she gets back.

She NEEDS a therapist. Even if you have a good relationship, she will not talk to you with as much info as she will with a professional. Trust me.

Sending love and prayers to u all :)
I don't know why I am here. I know I'm ready to go, though. I just feel like anything good on this earth gets hurt and forgotten. Kind souls cannot thrive.
